ruleDefinitions.name: Azure Kubernetes RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding Modified and Deleted
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation or patching of potential malicious RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding. Note: Unmapped fields: operationName

sequences.query: (operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLEBINDINGS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/CLUSTERROLEBINDINGS\/DELETE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLEBINDINGS\/WRITE" OR operationName = "MICROSOFT\.KUBERNETES\/CONNECTEDCLUSTERS\/RBAC\.AUTHORIZATION\.K8S\.IO\/ROLEBINDINGS\/DELETE")
